items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And that's where I first heard Woody Herman's band.

ctx.x: Right, right. Then they had the Empire Room on the west side of the street, just north of there. And that's where I first heard Woody Herman's band. That's when he had the Four Brothers and Ralph Burns and Dave Tough... He had a lot of really great players with the band during that period.
